chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Abī al-Miʿzā, from ʿAlī, from al-ʿAbd al-Ṣāliḥ عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: May a man use dye while he is junub? He said: There is no harm in it. And about a woman using dye while she is menstruating? He said: There is no harm in it.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.جُنُبٌ: a person in a state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.يَخْتَضِبُ: applies dye, especially as a form of grooming or coloration

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to use dye while in janabah or during menstruation?
ai.summary: This hadith states that there is no objection to a man applying dye while in a state of janabah, nor to a woman applying dye while menstruating. It indicates the permissibility of such grooming practices during these states of ritual impurity.
